greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Uthando lukaThixo uYise, ubabalo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kunye nokuhlalisana koMoya oyiNgcwele makube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho uBenjamin Vo, esesemncinci, ehlala phantsi phambi kwekhompyutha yakhe, ebhala iikhowudi zokudala umdlalo omtsha okanye ecwangcisa indlela i-'con chim airlines' yakhe eya kubhabha ngayo. Kwakukho ukuzimisela okukhulu emehlweni akhe, ukuzimisela okungazange kwabangelwa kukufuna ukubonwa ngabantu, kodwa ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda inyaniso yento awayeyenza. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwakha, ukudala, nokuzisa uvuyo. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos uthi: 'Ngenxa yokuba wayeyithanda inyaniso yento awayeyenza.' Umpostile usikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abuyiyo imidlalo yokukholisa abantu, kodwa bubudlelwane obunzulu noKristu. 

KwiVangeli, uYesu udibana noMartha noMariya. UMartha uxakekile, uziva ebunziwe, efuna ukwenza konke. Uthi kuYesu: 'Nkosi, awukhathali na ukuba udadewethu undishiyile ndedwa ukuba ndikhonze?' UYesu akamgxeki uMartha ngenxa yokusebenza kwakhe, kodwa umbiza kwinto ebalulekileyo: 'Martha, Martha, uxhalabile kwaye uzixhalabisile ngezinto ezininzi. Kukho imfuneko yento enye kuphela.' UBen wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa wayeyazi le nto 'enye'. Wayeyazi ukuba ukubaluleka kobomi akukho ekwenzeni izinto ezininzi, kodwa ekubeni nentliziyo evulekileyo.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba iinyanga ezintathu ezi zidlulileyo bezinzima kakhulu. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho intliziyo iziva ngathi iyaphuka, xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayeza kuwe, owayekuthanda, owayekujonga ngamehlo anothando. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda. Luza ngexesha lalo, lunzima, lufuna indawo. Ndaye ndifuna ukuba uthethe inyaniso yale ntliziyo yakho namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

Khumbula indlela uBen awayenentliziyo enobubele ngayo. Khumbula loo mzuzu xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe zizifo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, akazange ayikhuphule ngokoqobo, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Wayengumfana owayenokunikela ngayo yonke into yakhe ngaphandle kokubala. Wayengumfana owayephila ngoxolo lukaKristu. WayengumSamariya olungileyo ebomini bakhe, ebonisa uthando olungenamiqathango. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngoluxolo. Wayengumfana owayezisa uxolo ekhaya.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe, ekukhathalele, kwaye uthando lwenu aluzange lufe. Vumela uYesu abe lulwalwa lwakho namhlanje. Thatha igama likaBen, thandaza kuye uThixo, kwaye uqhubeke uphila ngesibindi, wazi ukuba akukho lizwi linye lothando olulahlekileyo phambi koThixo. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

UYesu uthi: 'Mariya ukhethe eyona nxalenye ilungileyo.' Lo ngumyalelo wethu namhlanje. Hamba, uthande njengokuba uBen wayethanda. Hamba, ube nomfesane njengokuba uBen wayenaye. Hamba, ube nentliziyo evulekileyo njengokuba uBen wayenayo. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Siya kukukhumbula njalo, side sidibane kwakhona apho kungekho nyembezi, apho kukho uvuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanyanisa ngokupheleleyo nawe. Ungandivumeli ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Nkosi, sikelela le ntsapho, ubanike amandla kunye noxolo olungapheliyo. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana noodade, nivile ngendlela yam yobomi yakuqala kubuYuda, indlela endalutshutshisa ngayo iBandla likaThixo ngokugqithisileyo, ndizama ukulitshabalalisa, kwaye ndaqhubela phambili kubuYuda ngaphezu kwabaninzi kwizizukulwana zam, kuba ndandingumkhuthali wamasiko ookhokho bam. Kodwa xa yena, owandahlula kwasesizalweni sikanina wandibiza ngobabalo lwakhe, wakholiseka ukutyhila uNyana wakhe kum, ukuze ndimvakalise kwiiNtlanga, andizange ndibonisane nanyama negazi ngoko nangoko, kwaye andizange ndinyuke ndiye eYerusalem kwabo babengabaPostile ngaphambi kwam; endaweni yoko, ndaya eArabhiya ndaza ndabuyela eDamasko. Emva kweminyaka emithathu ndanyuka ndaya eYerusalem ukuyobonisana noKefa, ndahlala naye iintsuku ezilishumi elinesihlanu. Kodwa andizange ndibone namnye omnye wababaPostile, kuphela nguYakobi umzalwana weNkosi. (Ngokuphathelele oko ndikubhalelayo, khangela, phambi koThixo, andixoki.) Emva koko ndaya kwimimandla yaseSiriya neKilikhiya. Ndingaziwa ngobuso ngamabandla aseYuda akristu; babesiva nje ukuba, 'Lowo wayesitshutshisa ngaphambili ngoku uvakalisa ukholo awayezama ukulitshabalalisa.' Baza bamdumisa uThixo ngenxa yam.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni engunaphakade. Nkosi, undivavanyile, uyandazi; uyazi xa ndihleli, xa ndimile; uziqonda iingcinga zam ukususela kude. Uhambo lwam nokuphumla kwam uyakuhlola, kwaye uzazi zonke iindlela zam. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni engunaphakade. Inene, ubumile ubukho bam bangaphakathi; undilukile esizalweni sikanina. Ndiyakubulela ngokuba ndenziwe ngokoyikekayo nangokumangalisayo; imisebenzi yakho iyamangalisa. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni engunaphakade. Umphefumlo wam wawuwazi kakuhle; namathambo am ayengafihlakele kuwe, xa ndandenziwa ngasese, xa ndandibunjwa nzulu emhlabeni. R. Khokela mna, Nkosi, endleleni engunaphakade.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wangena emzaneni apho umfazi ogama linguMarta wamkelayo. Wayenodadewabo ogama linguMariya owayehleli ecaleni kweNkosi ezinyaweni zakhe, emphulaphule ethetha. UMarta, exakekile kukukhonza okuninzi, weza kuye wathi, 'Nkosi, awukhathali na ukuba udadewethu undishiyile ndedwa ukuba ndikhonze? Mcele ukuba andincede.' INkosi yaphendula yathi kuye, 'Marta, Marta, uxhalabile kwaye uzixhalabisile ngezinto ezininzi. Kukho imfuneko yento enye kuphela. UMariya ukhethe eyona nxalenye ilungileyo, kwaye ayisayi kususwa kuye.'

day: Tuesday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
